description: Kernel only and complete call times of the existing and adaptive forward kernels and the eager composition on one card. One machine, one driver, one toolkit, bounded sizes. No general speed claim.
limits: One RTX 4090 with unlocked clocks in one Windows machine, torch 2.9.1 with its CUDA 12.8 runtime and the sizes N<=4096, 1<=D<=128 and 0<=B<=128. This script checks the card, the platform and torch. The toolkit that compiled the wheel is named by the build log, not checked here. Backward kernels are unchanged and untimed. Times are from event pairs and from the host clock as the protocol in FORWARD_KERNEL.md describes.

environment.conditions: working desktop: timed beside the ordinary work of a desktop in use, accepting up to 90 percent utilization before the start, with utilization and memory recorded before the start and before and after every case
environment.nsight_compute: unavailable: ncu is not on PATH

protocol.draw: values, logits and upstream for every case with randn and clamp to [-6,6] where the study clamps, in the order cpu study, bound, sweep. upstream is unused.
protocol.complete_call: torch.cuda.synchronize, perf_counter_ns, one call, torch.cuda.synchronize, perf_counter_ns
protocol.kernel_only: CUDA event pairs inside _forward_study behind a stream hold, one block per candidate and round
protocol.while_timing: torch.inference_mode, garbage collection off, one intraop and one interop thread

candidates.A: kernel 1, switch from the width rule pool uses with adaptive

switch_rule.rule: min(128, 8 * (32 / row_lanes(D))), so a lane of the lone warp walks at most 8 rows and at most 4 items in the maximum and the weights
switch_rule.previous_rule: min(32, 8 * (32 / row_lanes(D))), recorded on sweep rows and not judged

relations.<: left median more than 10 percent below the right
relations.~: medians within 10 percent of the smaller
relations.chains: every pair a chain implies is judged, see judge in the script

E.note: No kernel launches for an empty batch. The event pairs enclose no work.

N.note: No kernel launches for an empty batch. The event pairs enclose no work.

A.note: No kernel launches for an empty batch. The event pairs enclose no work.
